description: The provided image is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset, which is designed for multi-modal entity linking. The chart is divided into five distinct segments, each representing a different topic category: Common, Person, Book, and Sport, with the remaining segment labeled as "Topics" in the legend. The largest segment, colored light blue, represents the "Common" category, accounting for 41.2% of the dataset. The second largest segment, in light pink, corresponds to the "Person" category, making up 30.5%. The "Book" category is represented by a light yellow segment, comprising 9.1% of the data. The "Sport" category, shown in light purple, constitutes 4.3%. The smallest segment, in light green, represents the "Common" category and accounts for 14.9%. The chart includes a legend on the right side that matches the colors to their respective topics, and each segment is labeled with its corresponding percentage. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with the "Common" category at the top and moving through "Person," "Book," "Sport," and the remaining "Common" category. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of the "Common" and "Person" topics, which together represent over 70% of the dataset.
